implementation.public_path: Live particle-smoke and grid-smoke resources execute the production realtime-single-step schedule instead of the former blanket PM_ERROR_FEATURE_NOT_PRESENT rejection.
implementation.particle_tick: One bounded emission and predictor, one common spatial build/query/publication, six density/pressure-position/apply sweeps, one velocity commit and one public export.
implementation.grid_tick: One fixed source application, scalar and face advection, buoyancy/force preparation, boundary enforcement, twelve projection cycles, velocity correction, particle tracing and one public export.
implementation.common_epoch: Particle-smoke swept particles occupy reserved ranges of the F8-10 spatial epoch used by every active domain. Frozen filtering plus two frozen bounded gathers convert global spatial sources to the F8-16 local 64-wide candidate view without changing the protected Slang closure.
implementation.fixed_resources: All realtime particle, grid, candidate-adapter and publication storage is planned before execution. A tick performs no heap allocation, readback or index rebuild inside smoke domain iterations.
implementation.atomic_state: Particle and grid state publishes only after successful resource, snapshot and spatial commit. Exact-limit failure leaves public bytes unchanged; whole-resource replacement and reset renew generation/revision identity.
implementation.adapters: CUDA, Vulkan and Metal dispatch bindings call the common protected F8-16 Slang entries. Adapter code contains no private smoke physics equations.
